newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Sampoerna says sells Astra stake.
newsitem.headline: Sampoerna says sells Astra stake.

text.p: Indonesia's cigarette giant PT Hanjaya Mandala Sampoerna said on Thursday it had liquidated its 2.85 percent stake in PT Astra International.
"As a result of internal discussions and consultation with many of our share- and bondholders, the company liquidated its stake in Astra on Tuesday," the firm said in a statement.
Sampoerna said the Capital Market Supervisory Agency (Bapepam) was notified of the transaction.
It said the company purchased 33.181 million Astra shares for 157.61 billion rupiah in the last week of September at an average price of 4,750 rupiah per share.
Sampoerna said all the shares were sold on the market on Tuesday at an average price of 5,000 rupiah per share for a total of 165.91 billion rupiah. It did not identify any buyers.
